verdict.rationale: monday.com's own pages say it offers SDKs for building custom apps and integrations. They also describe a code-first apps framework, open-source Vibe React components, and programmatic control of agents from your own code. However, the SDKs are named only once, briefly, with no languages, packages, or reference docs. missing for 10: named SDK packages and supported languages, SDK reference documentation, AI-specific or agent SDK details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our flexible APIs, SDKs to build custom apps and integrations tailored to your  unique needs.
or build code-first with the apps framework.
Build with Vibe, monday's open-source React components, and look native instantly.
Run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code, anywhere you need it.
